files.competition-terms.md:
# Redmire Angling Club - competition terms

These terms apply to every match the club runs in the 2026 season.

## 1. Entries
Match entries are taken at the lodge or through the club's post box. A peg is held once the entry fee is paid.

## 2. Withdrawals
An angler who withdraws from a match gets the entry fee back when the withdrawal reaches the match secretary at least 5 days before the match date. A withdrawal that arrives later loses the fee.

## 3. Pegs
Pegs are drawn on the morning of the match and are not swapped afterwards.

## 4. Keepnets
Keepnets are dipped before they go in the water and are checked at the weigh-in.

# Redmire Angling Club - 2026 fixtures

The season runs from 4 April 2026 to 27 September 2026.
The club championship is fished over two matches in August.

If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
